comparison.candUnfolded:
∀ (transport : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 9) ≃ᵢ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3 × Fin 3)) (witness : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 9))),
  IsCompact (⇑transport '' witness) ∧
    Metric.diam (⇑transport '' witness) = √2 ∧
      ¬∃ C,
          (∀ (i : Fin 10), C i ⊆ ⇑transport '' witness) ∧
            ⇑transport '' witness ⊆ ⋃ i, C i ∧ ∀ (i : Fin 10), Metric.diam (C i) < √2
comparison.refUnfolded:
∀ (transport : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 9) ≃ᵢ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3 × Fin 3)) (witness : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 9))),
  IsCompact witness ∧
    Metric.diam witness = √2 ∧
      ¬∃ C, (∀ (i : Fin 10), C i ⊆ witness) ∧ witness ⊆ ⋃ i, C i ∧ ∀ (i : Fin 10), Metric.diam (C i) < √2
